bullets.text: Samsung and SoftBank Collaborate - **Samsung** and **SoftBank** join forces on 6G and AI-driven RAN technologies.
Vodafone's AI Network Automation - **Vodafone** partners with Zinkworks to enhance 5G operations using AI.
PSTN Switch-Off Deadline Approaches - UK businesses must transition to all-IP networks by January 2027.
T-Mobile US Sees Record Growth - **T-Mobile US** reports 2.35 million new postpaid customers in Q3 2025.
ZTE Wins Connectivity Award - **ZTE** recognized for its innovative indoor connectivity solutions at Network X 2025.
Germany's Fibre Transition Gains Pace - **Vodafone Germany** launches new fibre tariffs to boost broadband uptake.
Amigo Mesh Network for Protesters - New mesh network aims to keep political protesters connected during internet blackouts.
MasOrange Achieves Merger Synergies - **MasOrange** reports €259 million in synergies from its merger integration.
5G FWA Growth Forecast - Global 5G FWA subscriptions expected to reach 150 million by 2030, driven by India and the US.
Connected Britain Event Highlights - **Total Telecom** discusses the evolution of connectivity at Connected Britain 2025.
